Discover refined waterfront living in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City at the prestigious District One Phase III. This luxurious 4-bedroom villa is designed to offer an exceptional lifestyle with contemporary architecture, expansive interiors, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Set within one of Dubai’s most sought-after gated communities, the residence combines privacy, elegance, and connectivity, making it an ideal family home or investment opportunity.
